items.title: Genetic engineering ki do bunyadi technologies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the two technologies of genetic engineering (PDF 155).

blocks.text: Genetic engineers do bunyadi technologies par bharosa karte hain.

blocks.caption: Do bunyadi technologies
rows: aik jandar ke DNA ka tukra kaat kar doosre ke DNA mein 'chipka' deti hai
DNA ke nanhe hisse ko tezi se bari miqdar mein barha deti hai

blocks.title: Kaat-chipkao aur photocopy
blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology aik document se jumla kaat kar doosre mein chipkane jaisi hai; PCR aik safhe ko baar baar photocopy machine se guzarne jaisi hai.

blocks.prompt: Jaaye-waqia ke DNA ke chhote namoone ki millions copies banane ke liye kaun si technology use karenge?
blocks.explanation: PCR, jo DNA ke nanhe hisse ko bari miqdar mein barhati hai.

items: Recombinant DNA: jandaron ke darmiyan DNA kaat-chipkao.
PCR: chhote DNA tukre ko barhana.
